notes.title: Beta Information
notes.content:
We'll be hosting a closed beta test for Pixel Strike 3D prior to release to make sure everything is running smoothly! Over the next few weeks we'll be sending out more and more invites. Use the link below to sign up:

[url=http://pixelstrike3d.com/index.php?pages/beta/]Sign-up for the beta test[/url]

As with any beta keep in mind it will not be a finished product, and you may find some bugs and missing features. 


[h2]Pixel Strike 3D will be Crossplatform![/h2]
[b]How will this work?[/b]
Its very simple:

Mobile players can play on Mobile servers [i][b]or [/b][/i]Crossplatform servers. If you don't want to play with PC players, you don't have to. If you want to, you can!

PC players can [i][b]only [/b][/i]play on Crossplatform servers. The only way a PC player can play with a Mobile player is if the Mobile player connects to a Crossplatform server.

[b]Can I play with my Mobile account on PC?[/b]

You can! On PC there is an option to link your Mobile account to your Steam account so you can use the same account on both Mobile and PC

[b]Can PC and Mobile players play together?[/b]

Yes, as long as the Mobile player connects to a Crossplatform server. If you try to join a friend who is on a Crossplatform server you will get a popup to switch servers just like if they were on EU and you were on NA.

[url=https://discord.gg/ps3d][img]https://i.imgur.com/aMfDf6N.png[/img][/url]
